reports.title: XPENG Reports Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects:

• | Deliveries of vehicles to be between 169,000 and 174,000, representing a year-over-year increase of approximately 45.38% to 49.68%, and a quarter-over-quarter increase of approximately 42.75% to 46.97%.

• | Total revenues to be between RMB30.40 billion and RMB31.80 billion, representing a year-over-year increase of approximately 36.61% to 42.90%, and a quarter-over-quarter increase of approximately 25.23% to 30.99%.
The above outlook is based on the current market conditions and reflects the Company’s preliminary estimates of market and operating conditions, and customer demand, which are all subject to change.

desk.headline: Revenue up 19% to RMB24.3bn, beat; Q4 outlook of RMB30.4–31.8bn on 45–50% delivery growth
results: Revenue rose 19% to RMB24.3bn ($3.62bn), driven by more deliveries and a richer model mix.
Deliveries reached 118,390, up only 2% on last year but 15% higher than Q2.
Gross margin slipped to 18.9% as high-margin technical service income fell; vehicle margin improved to 13.1% from 12.1% in Q2.
Net loss widened to RMB0.87bn from RMB0.38bn a year ago but narrowed from RMB1.34bn in Q2.
Cash rose to RMB45.4bn; October deliveries were 50,237.

guidance.summary: For Q4 XPeng expects 169,000–174,000 deliveries (up 45–50% y/y) and revenue of RMB30.4–31.8bn (up 37–43% y/y).

points: Monthly sales were expected to top 60,000 for the first time in November, helped by the new MONA L05.
Overseas sales of about 100,000 this year are targeted to more than double in 2027; export margins are said to be over twice domestic.
Costlier memory chips, a battery tax and a lower export VAT rebate weigh on margins; 2026 gross margin is seen in the high teens.
IRON humanoid robot mass production is set to start in January 2027; robotaxi operations begin in Q4 in Guangzhou.
Management wants the car business cash-positive and profitable in the short to medium term to fund AI work.
call.source: Q3 2026 call summary — BigGo Finance, 16 Nov 2026; CnEVPost, 16 Nov 2026

watch: Whether November–December deliveries reach about 60,000 a month to hit Q4 guidance.
Margin pressure from memory chip costs and the export tax change in 2027.
Start of humanoid robot production and first robotaxi revenue.
